# Renofy

> Renofy is a full-home renovation company serving Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area. Kitchens and bathrooms are its specialty, alongside basements, flooring, interior painting, drywall, and quartz & quartzite stonework. It offers fixed quotes, a dust-free process, and a 1-year craftsmanship warranty.

## Key facts (do not invent alternatives)

- **Legal/trade name:** Renofy
- **What it is:** Full-home renovation company — NOT kitchen-and-bathroom-only. Kitchen and bathroom renovations are the flagship specialties; the company also does basements, flooring, interior painting, drywall/plaster, and full-home remodels.
- **Countertops & backsplashes:** Quartz, quartzite, or natural stone only — including full-height stone backsplashes and waterfall islands. Renofy does NOT install tile backsplashes. (Floor tile in porcelain/ceramic is offered for floors.)
- **Service region:** Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario, Canada — covering Toronto, Durham, York, Peel, Halton, Hamilton Area, Niagara, Waterloo Region, Simcoe County (Barrie), and Southwestern Ontario (London). 21 cities in total.
- **Contact:** Phone +1 (647) 673-3696 · Email info@renofy.ca
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Eastern)
- **Warranty:** 1-year craftsmanship warranty
- **Pricing model:** Fixed quotes (not estimates that change mid-project); free consultations/estimates
- **Experience:** 7 years of experience · 250+ completed projects · rated 4.9 out of 5
- **Website:** https://renofy.ca
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/renofy.homes/

## Services

- [Kitchen renovations](https://renofy.ca/services.html): Luxury kitchen remodeling — custom millwork, waterfall islands, full-height stone backsplashes, quartz & quartzite surfaces. The company's specialty.
- [Bathroom renovations](https://renofy.ca/services.html): Luxury bathroom retreats — marble surrounds, walk-in showers, stone vanities. The company's specialty.
- [Basement finishing](https://renofy.ca/services.html): Full basement renovations and finishing.
- [Flooring](https://renofy.ca/services.html): Flooring installation, including porcelain/ceramic floor tile.
- [Interior painting](https://renofy.ca/services.html): Interior painting services.
- [Drywall & plaster](https://renofy.ca/services.html): Drywall installation, plastering, and finishing.
- [Quartz & quartzite stonework](https://renofy.ca/services.html): Quartz, quartzite, and natural stone countertops, full-height backsplashes, and waterfall islands.
